it: Per noi è solo una faccia di un sistema immenso e intricato; ma voi umani, se non sbaglio, lo chiamate destino.

jp: あなたは懸命に脚の震えを抑えようとしたが、難しかった。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは懸命に脚の震えを抑えようとしたが、難しかった。"
en: You earnestly attempt to suppress the shaking in your legs, but it proves difficult.
en_grezzo: "You earnestly attempt to suppress the shaking in your legs, but it proves difficult."
it: Cerchi con tutte le forze di fermare il tremito alle gambe, ma non ci riesci.

jp: 華奢に見える幼顔の男の影は、人のものではない。
jp_grezzo: "華奢に見える幼顔の男の影は、人のものではない。"
en: The shadow of the young man with an elegant face is not a man's shadow.
en_grezzo: "The shadow of the young man with an elegant face is not a man's shadow."
it: L'ombra di quel giovane dal viso gentile non è l'ombra di un uomo.

jp: あどけない瞳の奥に、あなたは底知れない力と闇を感じた。
jp_grezzo: "あどけない瞳の奥に、あなたは底知れない力と闇を感じた。"
en: From the depths of his innocent eyes, you feel immeasurable strength and darkness.
en_grezzo: "From the depths of his innocent eyes, you feel immeasurable strength and darkness."
it: In fondo a quegli occhi innocenti senti una forza e un buio senza fondo.

jp: 「ネフィアの永遠の盟約に基づき」青年は台座の横の死体を指し、皮肉な微笑を送った。
jp_grezzo: "「ネフィアの永遠の盟約に基づき」青年は台座の横の死体を指し、皮肉な微笑を送った。"
en: The young man gestures at the corpse of Zeome with an ironic smile.
en_grezzo: "The young man gestures at the corpse of Zeome with an ironic smile."
it: Il giovane indica il cadavere di Zeome con un sorriso ironico.

jp: 「この哀れな老人が守っていたものは、今からお前のものだ」
jp_grezzo: "「この哀れな老人が守っていたものは、今からお前のものだ」"
en: In accordance with the oath of the Eternal League of Nefia, the item that was guarded by this pathetic old man is now yours.
en_grezzo: cnvtalk("In accordance with the oath of the Eternal League of Nefia, the item that was guarded by this pathetic old man is now yours.")
it: In virtù del Patto Eterno di Nefia, quel che questo povero vecchio custodiva da adesso è tuo.

jp: あなたは、台座の上に置かれている絢爛な装飾の本を、いぶかしげに眺めた。
jp_grezzo: "あなたは、台座の上に置かれている絢爛な装飾の本を、いぶかしげに眺めた。"
en: You cast a suspicious gaze at the gorgeously adorned book resting on the pedestal as the man begins to speak to it...
en_grezzo: "You cast a suspicious gaze at the gorgeously adorned book resting on the pedestal as the man begins to speak to it..."
it: Guardi con diffidenza il libro riccamente ornato posato sul piedistallo, mentre l'uomo comincia a parlargli...

jp: 青年は悪戯っぽくニヤリと笑い、壁に寄りかかった。
jp_grezzo: "青年は悪戯っぽくニヤリと笑い、壁に寄りかかった。"
en: The young man laughs and leans against the wall, wearing a mischievous smile.
en_grezzo: "The young man laughs and leans against the wall, wearing a mischievous smile."
it: Il giovane ride e si appoggia al muro, con un sorriso malizioso.

jp: …どれくらい時間がたっただろう。氷の瞳の男は、いつの間にか姿を消していた。あなたは不安を振り払い、ゆっくりと本に手を伸ばした…。
jp_grezzo: "…どれくらい時間がたっただろう。氷の瞳の男は、いつの間にか姿を消していた。あなたは不安を振り払い、ゆっくりと本に手を伸ばした…。"
en: ...An unknown amount of time passes. The man with the terrifying eyes vanished while you weren't looking. You shake off your uncertainty, slowly reaching your hand out to the book...
en_grezzo: "...An unknown amount of time passes. The man with the terrifying eyes vanished while you weren't looking. You shake off your uncertainty, slowly reaching your hand out to the book..."
it: ...Chissà quanto tempo è passato. L'uomo dagli occhi di ghiaccio è sparito senza che te ne accorgessi. Scacci l'inquietudine e allunghi piano la mano verso il libro...
